title: SillyTavern Presence
summary: Extension that tracks which characters were present in group chat and hides unobserved messages from individual character contexts.
documentation_observations: README documents per-message presence flags, editing attendees after an exchange and exclusion of absent messages.
It does not apply to individual chats; its narrator setting can deliberately see everything.
limitations: Documentation reviewed, but no local install or independent performance/privacy test has been run; memory separation and adult-content compatibility require explicit reproduction.
